# Endangered Languages Documentation Programme (ELDP)

> ELDP funds and supports the documentation, preservation, and digital archiving of endangered languages worldwide through grants, training, and collaborative projects.

Founded in 2002 and based at the Berlin Brandenburg Academy, ELDP is an Arcadia-funded initiative dedicated to preventing language extinction through systematic documentation and community engagement. The organization provides grants for linguistic fieldwork, legacy material digitization, training in documentation tools, and maintains a global archive of language resources.

- [Endangered Languages Documentation Programme (ELDP)](https://www.eldp.net): ELDP homepage: preserving endangered languages globally with resource repository
- [What We Do](https://www.eldp.net/en/what+we+do): ELDP mission: language preservation through documentation, grants, and digital archiving
- [About Us](https://www.eldp.net/en/about+us): ELDP overview with indigenous language projects and linguistic preservation initiatives
- [Who We Are](https://www.eldp.net/en/about+us/who+we+are): ELDP founded 2002: organization overview, team, and Arcadia funding details
- [Affiliated Grant Programmes](https://www.eldp.net/en/about+us/affiliated+grant+programmes): Arcadia-funded cultural heritage programs affiliated with ELDP
- [Contact](https://www.eldp.net/en/about+us/contact): ELDP contact: Berlin Brandenburg Academy address, email, and mailing list

## Grants & Funding

- [ELDP Grants Overview](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+grants): ELDP grant programs for language documentation and legacy material digitization
- [Documentation Grants](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+grants/documentation+grants): ELDP documentation grants for linguistic research with no nationality restrictions
- [Legacy Material Grants](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+grants/legacy+material+grants): ELDP grants for digitizing legacy language recordings and archival materials
- [How to Apply](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+grants/apply): ELDP grant application guidelines, deadlines, and eligibility criteria
- [Grant Review Process](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+grants/review+process): ELDP grant review process, expert panel, and selection criteria

## Training & Resources

- [About ELDP Trainings](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+trainings/about): ELDP training programs in language documentation, annotation, and archiving
- [Grantee Training](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+trainings/grantee+training): ELDP grantee training in Berlin: ELAN, FleX, and data management tools
- [Online Training Series 2026](https://www.eldp.net/en/our+trainings/online+training+series+2026): ELDP 2026 online training series in Spanish for Latin American language documentation
